messages:
maria-support: Heads up — multiple customers reporting intermittent 502/504s from the hosted API starting ~2024-10-09T14:05:xxZ. High volume of reports from two major tenants. Example trace/correlation: trace=tr-7b9c4f2a; req_id=rid-8a1c. Error patterns look like gateway 502 from edge. Customers see long timeouts then 502s. Can SRE/edge look? :rotating_light:

deploy-bot: Deploy completed: revision=canary-2024.10.09-03 at 2024-10-09T14:02:10Z (pods edge-proxy-v2=5 -> 8). No rollback scheduled.

sam-sre: On it. First pass: are these isolated regions or global? Any correlation with auth/token errors or billing header churn?

maria-support: Mostly US-West and EU regions (two separate tenants). Support saw a spike in auth failures (401s) for a subset of calls ~14:04 but customers mostly show 502/504 at the edge rather than 401s.

lee-edge: Pinging edge infra. Quick look at envoy stats from a pod in us-west-1:

```
# envoy stats excerpt
cluster.cluster_auth.token_service.upstream_rq_time_ms: 1200
listener.0.0.0.0_8080.downstream_rq_5xx: 178
listener.0.0.0.0_8080.downstream_rq_504: 53
server.http2.0.downstream_cx_overflow: 42
server.http2.0.downstream_rq_pending_overflow: 40
server.conns_active: 380
server.conns_total: 20000
```

lee-edge: That `downstream_cx_overflow` and `rq_pending_overflow` jump looks like H2 stream exhaustion / head-of-line from slow upstream auth. Also seeing auth upstream latency ~1.2s spikes in token service.

anna-platform: I pulled control-plane logs — a rate-limit policy was pushed as part of the canary at 14:01 that hard-caps request concurrency to a low value for the /v1/invoke path (intended for a different customer group). Policy id: rl-2024-10-09-01. It looks like traffic was misrouted to that policy during canary rollout.

sam-sre: That matches. If rate limit reduces concurrent upstreams while token service is slow, H2 streams back up and envoys give 504/502. Can we confirm traffic hitting the wrong rule?

anna-platform: Yes. I grep'd logs for policy id: many edge proxies in US-West inherited rl-2024-10-09-01 due to a label mismatch in the canary selector. We should roll that config back immediately.

maria-support: Customers are asking for ETA and temporary workarounds. Any mitigation short of full rollback?

lee-edge: Temporary mitigations:
- Increase envoy `max_concurrent_streams` and bump connection pool sizes (hot patch) OR
- Enable auth-token cache TTL fallback so requests don't synchronously hit token service on every request (low-risk) OR
- Rollback the misapplied rate-limit config (recommended).

sam-sre: I'll start rollback of the rate-limit policy and coordinate with platform to revert canary selector. @anna-platform, can you push rollback now?

anna-platform: Rolling back rl-2024-10-09-01 from the control plane now. Command: `kubectl -n controlplane patch configmap ratelimits --type json -p '[{"op":"remove","path":"/policies/rl-2024-10-09-01"}]'` — executing.

oncall-bot: Pager acknowledged by sam-sre. Incident priority: P2.

sam-sre: While rollback is propagating, enabling auth-cache fallback on a couple of edge pods (us-west-1) to reduce upstream auth calls. Patch command: `kubectl -n edge rollout restart deployment/edge-proxy --env=AUTH_CACHE_FALLBACK=true`. Doing controlled restart on 2/8 pods.

lee-edge: Also temporarily increased envoy `circuit_breakers` for cluster_auth to 200 concurrent streams to avoid immediate overflow on slow upstream. Hot patch pushed to us-west-1 edge nodes.

maria-support: Customer reports coming down from 14:18. Monitoring dashboards show downstream 5xx and 504s trending back to baseline. :thumbsup:

anna-platform: Rollback confirmed completed at 2024-10-09T14:22:05Z. Config map change propagated to all regions.

sam-sre: All mitigations rolled out. Observed error rates: downstream_rq_5xx back to normal within ~3 minutes post-rollback. Correlation: canary rate-limit + transient token service latency = H2 stream saturation -> 502/504s.

maria-support: Passed update to customers, they confirm recovery. Logging final traces for postmortem: trace examples tr-7b9c4f2a, tr-9d2f3e11, tr-cc4a2b55.

lee-edge: Action items:
- platform: tighten canary selectors to avoid policy bleed (anna-platform)
- infra: consider default higher `max_concurrent_streams` or better h2 queueing (sam-sre)
- auth team: investigate token service 1.2s latency spike around 14:04 (follow-up ticket created)
- runbook: update edge runbook to include misapplied rate-limit rollback steps and auth-cache quick enablement.

maria-support: Thanks all. Closing thread once postmortem is posted.

oncall-bot: Incident closed by sam-sre at 2024-10-09T14:31:40Z.
